claim_boundary: Local single-node failure evidence only; no production SLA, HA, multi-GPU, or customer-traffic claim.
corrective_action: Reduce and freeze closed concurrency from 128 to 64 before any acceptance run.
Retain enough concurrency to form batch 32 while reducing co-located client/API scheduling pressure.
Rerun the same three-repetition pilot at the new clean config revision before restarting the matrix.
next_action: Run the same three-repetition pilot at frozen concurrency 64; no result in this attempt contributes acceptance credit.
root_cause: Per-request trace ownership was fixed and every sampled chain completed, but closed concurrency 128 produced an unstable client-side latency tail: repetition three p99 exceeded the frozen hard stop while server queue p99, error count, OOM count, Prometheus, and cleanup remained bounded.
